comment: The help addresses the Koona Pin app links to (koona-pin src/services/help.ts keeps a copy of this file in its tests). Installed copies of the app keep these addresses for years: never remove a line, and never let its page or anchor disappear. Renaming a heading changes its anchor: keep the old one alive with the page's `aliases` (README, «Справка»). scripts/build.mjs fails the build when a page or anchor here is missing.
